You need to compare a given $patternTime string with current date-time and return true only if the input $patternTime is in the past, otherwise, return false. The input $patternTime can be in any format. Make sure your current date-time follows the exact same format as the input $patternTime when comparing. 
If the input $patternTime is in the past, return is true. Otherwise, the return is false.

Make sure do not provide any reasoning in your response. 
Example:
if the current date-time is "2025-10-05 13:12:03, and input $patternTime is "2025-09-04 10:02:00", your response should be: true.

Input text: $patternTime

Output:
